requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2292-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2292-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

304-1436-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
304-1436-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
304-1436-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tough Cookie.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

728-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
728-5254-6774.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

767-1424-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-1424-4687.description:
Activate Presence of Gond by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

339-677-4247-4742.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2692-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2073-5686-7877-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Voyager Glidecar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-3668.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-3668.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-3668.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1090-1895-2350-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4559-4779-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
4559-4779-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3764-6797-7363.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Mutagen.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

573-1558-3875-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1558-3875-4231-4321.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1739-1965-2034-5224.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

277-573-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
277-573-5451-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Gruul Turf.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1496-2034-3000-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1496-2034-3000-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

4484-4871-4924-5643-6797.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-4924-5643-6797.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-4924-5643-6797.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

277-4693-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
277-4693-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

575-3213-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-3213-5971.description:
Activate Boromir by sacrificing it.
When Boromir dies, Yedora triggers, returning Boromir from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Boromir enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Boromir by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Boromir face-up.
Resolve the Boromir ability from step 1.
Repeat.

803-1238-2351-2438-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

4970-4985-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
4970-4985-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-3220-4050.manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control a Saproling
222-3220-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-3220-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and another nontoken creature you control, adding {B}{R}.
When the creatures die, Golgari Germination triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {G}.
If you control two or more Saprolings, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

109-2134-5195.description:
Cast Bond of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, targeting Bond of Insight.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Fork, copying Bond of Insight.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Bond of Insight, causing each player to mill four cards and return Fork and any other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

3430-3525-3793-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
3430-3525-3793-5115.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding nine {C}.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

423-511-1770-3510.notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
423-511-1770-3510.description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers twice, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

328-628-2034-4417.notablePrerequisites: Gray Merchant does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
328-628-2034-4417.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant, adding {C}{C}.
Gray Merchant dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least five life and you to gain that much life.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1} and two life, removing the +1/+1 counter from Gray Merchant and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

148-1029-1284-1742.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow and Keen Sense attached to Tolarian Kraken.
Tolarian Kraken does not have summoning sickness.
148-1029-1284-1742.description:
Activate Tolarian Kraken by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap it.
Repeat.

3263-3525-4880.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Weaver of Currents.
Weaver of Currents does not have summoning sickness.
3263-3525-4880.description:
Activate Weaver of Currents by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Weaver of Currents.
Repeat.
